CGFloat(effectMultiplier) : 1), brightness: src.brightnessComponent * (darken ? CGFloat(effectMultiplier) : 1), alpha: 1) lookupTableData[ bufferIndex ] = UInt16(dest.redComponent * multiplier) bufferIndex += 1 lookupTableData[ bufferIndex ] = UInt16(dest.greenComponent * multiplier) bufferIndex += 1 lookupTableData[ bufferIndex ] = UInt16(dest.blueComponent * multiplier) bufferIndex += 1 } } } ```
